notes.title: Japanese language update + Summer Sale Discount Notice
notes.content:
Japanese is now available!
Players can switch to Japanese by right-clicking on the game name in the library and selecting Properties - Language - Japanese
Attention!
1. Due to lack of experience, only the subtitles have been changed.
2. Bugs may occur in the Japanese version that do not affect the game experience.
3. Switching to the Japanese version requires a version update.

Special emphasis here
Thank you from the bottom of my heart for the Japanese translation provided by the little angel Yuhan. Thank you!

Summer Sale Discount
This time we have a very long discount period.
From the Summer Sale until one week after the end of the Summer Sale.
The discount is 50 percent (50% off)
This is also the last major sale for "Last Days", so please support us if you like it.

Lastly, a few words
I know it's not perfect, but to me it's the best.
I am also grateful to those who have supported Last Days, without your support I don't know if I would continue to make new games.
I don't think there will be any more major updates or discounts in the future, but there are still two radio plays left for you to look forward to.
Please also continue to look forward to my future works. I can't guarantee that I will produce a masterpiece or a masterpiece in the future, but I can only guarantee that there will be enough progress each time.

Also
If you want to make all kinds of homages and second creations, please just make them.
I'm very supportive of homo sapiens w

Finally, thank you all.

notes.title: The "Last Days" game soundtrack is online!
notes.content:
Good evening to all players.
It's been ten days since the complete release of "Last Days".
During this time, we have received a lot of encouragement and love from our players.
This has made us even more enthusiastic about the next installment.

Although the first release discount has ended.
But fortunately, the game soundtrack has finally been approved.
We have released the soundtrack.
If you have already purchased the game itself.
You can get the soundtrack for free.

Steam address: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1771790/_Soundtrack/?beta=0

Next is the price increase notice for the game.
We priced the game at $6 in the beta because the game didn't have a full storyline at that time.
Now that the game has been released in full, the game should have been released at the time of the price increase.
But considering that the price increase on steam can not be discounted for 30 days.
For the sake of the first release discount we choose to temporarily slow down.
Now that everything is settled.
We have also decided to increase the price on 2021/10/15 19:00 BST.
The game body will be $0.99 to $2.99.
(China region from 6 RMB to 12 RMB)

We hope you can understand and continue to support us.
We are also working on the first part of the radio drama DLC.
It is expected that we can catch up with steam's winter sale.
If you think the price is too high after the price increase, you can also wait until then to get it.

Finally, welcome to join our player group: 953202123
We will often release the production process in the group, collect feedback, send red packets to give gifts, etc. ~

I wish you all a happy Wednesday.

notes.title: The End with God" is now available
notes.content:
The End with God" is now available

As long as your memories and emotions for me remain, then I will always be by your side.

Finally, finally! Finally, "The End with God" can be officially released!

From the project in January to the pre-test in August, and now to the official release in October. The end of the world with God" has gone through many trials and tribulations, and finally can fully meet with the players.

In the end of the world, what exactly can cross time and space to achieve eternity?

The story tells how the gods have been sheltering New Canaan for four hundred years since its inception, and everyone - including Sister Silver Snow - felt that this would go on forever, until the day Silver Snow met the gods of New Canaan. Since then, the story between the young girl who calls herself a god, and the young girl who will become a god begins.

The official release of this time, in addition to all the updates to the plot, but also some functional improvements.
1. added optional chapters function: each completed chapter can unlock the next chapter optional. 2.
2. added chapter transitions effect: allowing players to better understand their reading progress.
3. Added expression differential effect: According to the feedback from a large number of players, we added expression differential and corresponding performance for the main character in the later stage. However, because it is an additional addition, you can just consider it as icing on the cake.
4. optimized a large number of performances, subtitles and sound effects.
P.S.
Please note that due to the new feature, the previous archive may report an error, just overwrite the new one. Thanks for your understanding!

The original intention was to increase the price of the full version, but in view of the fact that the price can not be discounted for 30 days after the price increase, so in order to allow more players to experience "The End with God", we decided to slow down the progress of the price increase, first on the basis of the current price for the first 10% discount. In the future we will grow the price back again.

At the same time we allow live game related content, but please anchor attention to live norms, the occurrence of live accidents we are not responsible.

Video-related, second-created content is not limited, involving spoilers, please update the release after a week, so as not to affect the game experience of others.

Thank you for understanding w
Finally a preview of what's to follow.
1. free game soundtrack is in steam review, in the near future can be released.
2. there will be four DLC sound is in production, look forward to. 3.
3. the new work has been established, please like the glazed flower sugar production team players continue to pay attention to us ah!

I wish you all a good weekend w

notes.title: 2021-8-30 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, long time no see! Thank you for your support and playing our game. We are very, very, very happy to see such positive feedback after the second chapter of the plot update, and to see that the players like the main characters so much!

So thanks again!

The main thing about this update is...

Installed the third chapter of the plot content!

Silver Snow's choice, the truth of the world, the daily life of the girls ......
All in this chapter!

Finally, thank you again for your support and play of our work.
Have a nice Sunday (Monday) w

notes.title: 2021-8-21 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, long time no see! Thank you all for supporting and playing our game, we have looked at every comment and suggestion, and we are very, very, very happy to see that so many people like our game and are willing to give valuable advice!
So thanks again!

The content of this update, in addition to fixing some of the problems in the first chapter (such as the absence of some of the voice, the wrong sequence of speech, etc.)
There are two main parts.

The first is that we have recorded all the voices for the apocalypse and installed them.
The second is that after many internal tests and discussions, we finally decided to release the second chapter of the plot content.

Finally, we would like to thank you all again for your support and play of our work.
Have a nice Sunday w
